atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs reusable safety patterns for privileged operational assistants without exposing secrets to model context.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Direct autonomous server command execution could bypass protected-action and runtime authority boundaries.

claims.claim: The repository documents a local-first DevOps agent with secret placeholders, OS keychain storage, approval-by-default, command filters, and pre-change backups.
The documented security controls prevent all secret leakage or destructive execution in real deployments.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
